title: TRUCK TRAMPOLINE DODGEBALL
prompt: Create an original finished TRANSPARENT title logo for a 1998–2002 PS1/PS2 mascot arcade sports game. Required reference style: CHUNKY WOBBLY UNEVEN custom hand-lettering, strong sculpted angular bevels painted in THREE broad color planes, thick blue-black outline plus ivory keyline, low-poly faceted toy semi trucks with enormous wheels. Invent a distinct composition. NO realistic materials, no photographic detail, no shiny modern mobile logo, no fine noise. Crisp HD illustration, not pixel art. No panel/background scene, genuine alpha, ample clear margins. All exact words legible and unobscured. EXACT title: "TRUCK TRAMPOLINE DODGEBALL". Composition: Violet/coral comic letters bouncing over an oval striped trampoline underline, toy semi cab upside down in jump at LEFT, two big red rubber dodgeballs ricocheting around outside words. TRAMPOLINE smaller but accurately legible, DODGEBALL huge.
